name: oras-799bb3e9-blind30-ots
instr:
# A command-line client for OCI registries misbehaving in thirty places, and shipped without a test suite

I drive this command-line tool against OCI registries and against layouts saved on disk, and a great deal of what it does has quietly gone wrong. Nothing about the registries changed and nothing about the way I invoke it changed. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything odd I have been able to observe from the outside, set down in the order I ran into it.

Uploading one local document into a layout directory on disk under two tags now stops with a failure, and afterwards neither tag resolves there, even though I asked for nothing unusual and supplied no configuration of my own. Asking that same upload for an output shape the tool does not know no longer answers with the complaint about the unsupported kind; some other failure happens first and that message never appears. Uploading a single piece of raw payload to a registry also ends in a failure, and the line that should announce the finished upload with its kind, its hundred percent and its digest never gets printed. Retrieving one piece of raw payload back out into a destination on disk behaves the same way: the payload is plainly there at the source, yet the call fails and the finished-download line is missing.
